decision.dispatch.ready: The facility and every period are complete
decision.dispatch.terminal_help: Where the schedule leaves the facility, against any required ending inventory.

risk.method.var_proxy.summary: One-day 95% historical-simulation proxy over {{observations}} one-day changes of daily closes: the net open position per hub times each day's change in that hub's close, summed across hubs, and the loss at the 5th percentile. Given only with at least 250 changes (one year of trading days); with fewer it says not enough history.
risk.method.var_proxy.includes.legs: Physical contracts and filled screen trades in the books you can see
risk.method.var_proxy.includes.closes: One series per hub: its month-ahead closes from one source, or its day-ahead closes where no month-ahead history is held; a missing day is a gap, never filled with another product
risk.method.var_proxy.includes.rolls: Moves within one contract only: the day a rolling series changes contract, and a gap of more than four days, are not scenarios
risk.method.var_proxy.includes.index: Index-priced contracts by their flat-price exposure: on their index, not long or short the hub's flat price
risk.method.var_proxy.excludes.basis: Basis between delivery months: one price series per hub
risk.method.var_proxy.excludes.optionali: Optionality and volume flexibility in contracts
risk.method.var_proxy.excludes.offsettin: Hubs long in one delivery month and short in another: not computed
risk.method.mark_to_market.summary: Each leg valued as (mark minus contract price) times its remaining MWh, month by month, at the forward-curve mark for its hub and month, converted into the reporting currency at the forward FX for the delivery month and discounted to the month's payment date (the 20th of the month after) at that currency's overnight benchmark.
risk.method.mark_to_market.includes.legs: Physical contracts and filled screen trades in the books you can see
risk.method.mark_to_market.includes.curv: Forward curve from one snapshot of entitled quotes per hub: one as-of, settlements first, then the hub's main source, each quote no older than its tenor allows; a season or year is shaped by the quoted quarters; a month no quote prices is not available, never filled with another product's close
risk.method.mark_to_market.includes.inde: Index-priced contracts valued on their premium over the index's mark, and on the basis when the index is another hub's
risk.method.mark_to_market.includes.rate: Forward FX derived from the ECB reference rates and SONIA, €STR and SOFR (a licensed forward first); where none can be derived, the spot rate, and where no benchmark is held, undiscounted, as the read says
risk.method.mark_to_market.excludes.unpr: Legs without a mark, a contract price or an FX rate: counted as unvalued, not as zero
risk.method.mark_to_market.excludes.real: Realised P&L on gas already delivered
risk.method.tenor_exposure.summary: Net and gross position per hub over the delivery months held; gross is the sum of each month's absolute net position, what a curve shock acts on.
risk.method.tenor_exposure.includes.legs: Physical contracts and filled screen trades in the books you can see
risk.method.tenor_exposure.includes.inde: Flat-price exposure: an index-priced contract is on its index, so a contract priced at its own hub's index adds volume but no exposure
risk.method.tenor_exposure.excludes.pric: Prices: a volume figure, not a value
risk.method.tenor_shock.summary: Profit or loss if each named hub and month moved by the shock you entered, with everything else unchanged: net MWh times the shock, in the reporting currency.
risk.method.tenor_shock.excludes.correla: Moves in months you did not name
risk.method.tenor_shock.excludes.no_fx: Hubs without an ECB rate to the reporting currency
risk.method.credit_exposure.summary: Replacement exposure (undelivered volume at mark minus contract price, netted across the counterparty and floored at zero) plus receivables for the last receivable days of sales, minus collateral held; utilisation is that over the limit.
risk.method.credit_exposure.includes.leg: The counterparty's supply contracts and ETRM trades in the books you can see, marked as the position ladder marks them
risk.method.credit_exposure.includes.eve: Evergreen contracts only to the end of the current gas year
risk.method.credit_exposure.includes.rat: Replacement value at the forward FX for each delivery month, discounted to its payment date, as the ladder's mark-to-market
risk.method.credit_exposure.excludes.pfe: Potential future exposure: today's exposure only
risk.method.credit_exposure.excludes.unv: Legs without a mark, a price or an FX rate: counted as unvalued
risk.method.mandate_usage.summary: Largest net hub-month position in the mandate's books and on the trader's own account against the mandate's size limit, with its hubs, tenor, products and hedge band checked.
risk.method.mandate_usage.includes.legs: Physical contracts and filled screen trades in the mandate's books
risk.method.mandate_usage.includes.everg: Evergreen contracts only to the end of the current gas year
risk.method.mandate_usage.includes.index: Net size and hedge cover in flat-price exposure: an index-priced contract is on its index and needs no hedge
risk.method.mandate_usage.excludes.value: Prices and P&L: a volume limit, not a loss limit
risk.method.mandate_usage.excludes.other: Positions the trader holds in books outside this mandate
risk.method.pnl_snapshot.summary: Indicative P&L as the valuation snapshot states it, imported from its source and not recomputed here.
risk.method.pnl_snapshot.includes.source: The snapshot's own realised and unrealised components
risk.method.pnl_snapshot.excludes.costs: Costs the source does not include
risk.method.live_summary_pnl.summary: Sum of the latest P&L snapshots you can see, as imported; unknown, not zero, when no snapshot exists.
risk.method.live_summary_pnl.includes.sn: Imported valuation snapshots in the strategies you can see
risk.method.live_summary_pnl.excludes.bo: Snapshots carry no book: with book isolation only head office sees them
risk.method.day_pnl_change.summary: Net open position at the hub over the next 12 months times the change between its last two daily closes: the position ladder's flat-curve move, not a revaluation.
risk.method.day_pnl_change.includes.legs: Physical contracts and filled screen trades in the books you can see
risk.method.day_pnl_change.includes.clos: The hub's last two daily closes of one series (month-ahead, or day-ahead where no month-ahead history is held) and of one contract: no figure across a roll
risk.method.day_pnl_change.excludes.basi: Moves that differ between delivery months
risk.method.day_pnl_change.excludes.new_: The prices of trades done since the previous close: they count as if held at that close
risk.method.day_pnl_change.excludes.offs: Hubs long in one delivery month and short in another: not computed
risk.method.net_position.summary: Net MWh per gas day: long positive, contracts at their daily quantity and screen trades spread over their delivery days.
risk.method.net_position.includes.legs: Physical contracts and filled screen trades in the books you can see

setup.step.welcome.title: Welcome to Eurogas Nexus
setup.step.welcome.intro: A few pages to connect the data your desk uses. It takes about ten minutes; you can stop at any time.
setup.welcome.categories: One page per kind of data: open market data, prices and trading screens, LNG and shipping, weather, FX and rates, your book, AI, and people.

setup.welcome.environment: Your IT team configured this server from its settings; the pages show what is already on.
setup.step.open_data.title: Open market data
setup.step.open_data.intro: Free public data. Two providers ask you to accept their terms for the firm, and three need your own free key.
setup.step.prices.title: Prices and trading screens
setup.step.prices.intro: Licensed prices come only through your firm's own subscription. Record each licence; where no connector exists yet, your operations team imports the export you already receive.
setup.step.lng_shipping.title: LNG and shipping
setup.step.lng_shipping.intro: Vessel positions need your vessel-tracking entitlement; terminal tariffs are public at most terminals.
setup.step.weather.title: Weather
setup.step.weather.intro: ECMWF open data runs on its own. Add a licensed vendor only if your desk uses one.
setup.step.fx_rates.title: FX and rates
setup.step.fx_rates.intro: ECB reference rates and overnight rates run on their own. Licensed fixes are imported where contracts reference them.
setup.step.book.title: Your book
setup.step.book.intro: Positions, P&L and limits come from your own trades and contracts. These are imports or API keys for your systems.
setup.step.ai.title: AI
setup.step.ai.intro: Optional. A model writes the “Why”, the desk brief and alert analysis. It receives only the facts the screen shows for that use, never identifiers, and book figures only for people allowed to see them.
setup.step.people.title: People
setup.step.people.intro: Add the people who will use the product and give them their roles.

fb.method: Daily: the same days' measured demand in earlier years plus the last 14 days' deviation; no temperature forecast is held, so this assumes normal weather from here. Norway: 7-day average less announced outages; LNG: 14-day average; storage takes the difference. Monthly: a fitted weather rule (demand against Eurostat heating degree days, region weighted by sector gas use) at the 30-year normal; it is a transparent rule, not a promoted weather-demand model, and its ± is its own backtest. Outage uncertainty is not in the range.
